endpoints.description: Score overall portfolio risk with breakdown by market, concentration, liquidity, and correlation risk
Analyze portfolio concentration across assets, sectors, and geographies with Herfindahl index
Estimate correlations between holdings, identify clustering risk, and surface hedging opportunities
Run historical stress scenarios (GFC, COVID, rate shock) and estimate portfolio losses and recovery times
Analyze sector weights vs benchmark, identify overweight/underweight positions, and score active risk
Estimate max drawdown, VaR, CVaR, and time-to-recovery for the portfolio
Generate specific buy/sell trades to rebalance portfolio with tax and cost considerations
Validate portfolio data readiness before running risk analysis
ONE-CALL: full portfolio risk — risk score, concentration, sector tilts, stress test, and rebalancing priority
